damas.quals_rule_en: Full-time defined as 35 hrs/wk. Part-time (>=20 hrs/wk) counts pro-rata (2m PT = 1m FT). Concurrent experience counting allowed (ANZSCO substitution + DAMA visa experience counted simultaneously). SL4 (Group 8): Cert III + 1y (20h+) OR Cert II + 1.5y (20h+) OR 2y FT (35h). SL5 (Group 9): Cert I OR 1y FT (35h).
damas.quals_rule_ko: 풀타임 기준 주 35시간 인정. 파트타임(주 20시간+) 2개월=풀타임 1개월 합산 가능. 학위 대체 경력과 비자 경력 동시(Concurrent) 인정. SL4(Group 8): Cert III+1년(20h+) 또는 Cert II+1.5년(20h+) 또는 무학위 2년(35h). SL5(Group 9): Cert I 또는 무학위 1년(35h).
damas.pr_rule_en: Conditional Direct/Transition ENS 186 Labour Agreement stream: Requires 2 years full-time (35h/wk, or part-time equivalent) in the FNQ designated area in the nominated or closely related occupation. Qualifying work on non-DAMA temporary visas may count toward ENS 186 Labour Agreement nomination subject to visa compliance, employer DAR endorsement, Labour Agreement approval, and nomination criteria.
damas.pr_rule_ko: 조건부 ENS 186 Labour Agreement 경로: FNQ 지정지역 내 2년 풀타임(주 35시간 또는 파트타임 환산) 근무 후 전환. 일정 요건을 충족한 비-DAMA 임시비자 근무경력도 DAMA 482를 먼저 거치지 않는 ENS 186 Labour Agreement stream 경로에 인정될 수 있으나, 직종·지역·근무기간·비자조건 준수·고용주 DAR endorsement·Labour Agreement 및 nomination을 별도로 확인해야 합니다.
damas.lmt_rule_en: 2 national advertisements running >=28 days within 4 months prior to DAR endorsement (per FNQ LMT Factsheet).
damas.lmt_rule_ko: DAR 신청 전 4개월 이내 전국 구인매체 2곳 이상 최소 28일간 광고 필수 (FNQ LMT 가이드 기준).
damas.sunset_note_ko: 협약 유효기한: 2027.04.03까지 연장 (2025.03.22부 11개 공식 LGA 적용)
damas.sunset_note_en: Agreement extended to 3 April 2027 (11 official LGAs apply from 22 March 2025)

damas.salary_rule_ko: 103개 직종(전체 226개 중): CSIT 90%($71,481) Type 1(금전 급여) 또는 Type 2(금전 $71,481 이상 + 숙식 비금전 full CSIT의 10% 이하 최대 $7,942.30, 총액 $79,423 이상 및 시장임금 AMSR 이상).
damas.eng_rule_en: 58 occupations: 482/494 IELTS 5.0 overall (no band minimum); ENS 186 IELTS 5.0 overall (min 4.0 each band).
damas.eng_rule_ko: 58개 직종: 482/494 IELTS 5.0 평균(과목별 하한 없음) / 186 영주권 IELTS 5.0 평균(각 과목 4.0 이상).

damas.dar_en: MigrationNT (NT Department of Trade, Business and Asian Relations)
damas.document_version: NT DAMA III Concessions, Occupations List (325 rows) & PR Pathway (19 Mar 2026 / 1 Jul 2026)
damas.transition_effect_en: NT DAMA III operates until 30 June 2030. Employers holding labour agreements under previous NT DAMAs must be endorsed under NT DAMA III and enter into a new labour agreement to nominate for Subclass 186.
damas.transition_effect_ko: NT DAMA III는 2030년 6월 30일까지 운영됩니다. 구 NT DAMA 협약 보유 고용주가 186 노미네이션을 진행하려면 현행 NT DAMA III 재승인 및 신규 Labour Agreement 체결이 필요합니다.
damas.dar_fee_en: $0 DAR endorsement fee (Note: Commonwealth visa/nomination/SAF charges & external assessing authority fees where required are separate)
damas.dar_fee_ko: 주정부 DAR 승인 수수료 $0 (단, 연방 비자·노미네이션·SAF 수수료 및 외부 기술심사 기관 비용은 별도)
damas.lgas_en: Entire Northern Territory (Darwin, Palmerston, Litchfield, Alice Springs, Katherine, Tennant Creek / Barkly, Nhulunbuy / East Arnhem, Tiwi Islands, etc.)
damas.lgas_ko: 노던 테리토리(NT) 주 전역 (다윈 Darwin, 파머스턴, 앨리스스프링스 Alice Springs, 캐서린 Katherine 등 전 지역)
damas.quals_rule_en: SID 482 requires at least 1 year full-time experience across occupations (SL4 allows Cert III + 1y at 20h+/wk, Cert II + 1.5y at 20h+/wk, or 2y FT without quals). SESR 494 requires 2 years FT. Mandatory 28-day listing on NT WorkerConnect portal.
damas.quals_rule_ko: SID 482 경력 1년 풀타임 기준(SL4는 Cert III+1년 주20h+ 등 가능), SESR 494는 2년 풀타임. NT 주정부 WorkerConnect 포털 28일 구인공고 필수.
damas.pr_rule_en: Conditional ENS 186 Labour Agreement stream: Nominee must have worked in the NT for at least 2 years full-time (or part-time equivalent) in the ENS-nominated occupation or a closely related occupation at the same skill level, complied with visa conditions, and hold a full-time ongoing job offer for at least 2 years from an employer endorsed under current NT DAMA III with an active Labour Agreement. (Specific skills assessment and employer deed conditions must be verified per individual agreement/occupation schedule).
damas.pr_rule_ko: 조건부 ENS 186 Labour Agreement 경로: NT 내에서 최소 2년 풀타임(또는 파트타임 환산) 동안 노미네이션 직종 또는 동일 숙련도(Skill Level)의 밀접 관련 직종에서 근무하고 비자 조건을 준수해야 하며, 현행 NT DAMA III 승인(Endorsement) 및 Labour Agreement를 보유한 고용주의 최소 2년 이상 풀타임 고용 제안이 필요합니다 (기술심사 및 세부 고용주 요건은 개별 협약·직종 스케줄별 확인 필요).
damas.lmt_rule_en: Mandatory 28-day listing on Territory WorkerConnect portal + Commonwealth LMT requirements.
damas.lmt_rule_ko: NT 주정부 Territory WorkerConnect 포털 28일 구인공고 등록 및 연방 LMT 요건 충족 필수.
damas.sunset_note_ko: NT DAMA III 협약 기간: 2030.06.30까지 유효
damas.sunset_note_en: NT DAMA III active until 30 June 2030
damas.salary_rule_en: All 325 available occupations eligible for conditional up to 15% CSIT reduction ($67,510 monetary floor) ONLY where market salary (AMSR) is below CSIT; employer must always pay at least AMSR (conditional non-monetary cap up to $6,751).

damas.quals_rule_en: SID 482 requires 1 year FT experience; SESR 494 (Regional WA Category 3) requires 2 years FT; ENS 186 requires 3 years FT lived & worked in Metropolitan Perth (Category 2) OR 2 years FT lived & worked in Regional WA (Category 3) under original WA DAMA endorsement. Metro Perth businesses capped at 50% skilled migrants.
damas.quals_rule_ko: SID 482: 1년 풀타임 경력. SESR 494(Category 3 지방): 2년 풀타임. ENS 186: 원래 WA DAMA 승인을 통해 노미네이션된 근로자로서 Category 2(퍼스)는 3년 거주·근무, Category 3(서호주 지방)는 2년 거주·근무 필수. 퍼스 사업장은 외국인 비율 50% 이하 제한.

Nominees for this occupation must satisfy the skills, qualifications, experience and employment background required under the standard SID, SESR or ENS visa programs except : Have at least one (1) year of relevant work experience if applying for a SID or SESR visa where the relevant AQF qualification was obtained in Australia; OR Have at least two (2) years of relevant work experience if applying for a SESR visa in addition to the qualification; OR Have at least three (3) years of relevant work experience if applying for an ENS visa;
AND Work experience undertaken in lieu of a qualification can be served concurrently. Work experience must be: in the nominated occupation, or a related occupation at the same skill level must be undertaken in the last 5 years full-time or part-time pro-rata can be while studying through a formal arrangement such as internships, industry and clinical placements, apprenticeships and traineeships, and work experience required through the Job Ready Program, and can be served concurrently with any work experience used to substitute for formal qualifications as per ANZSCO requirements, provided that work experience was at the same skill level. In cases where work experience is used to substitute for formal qualifications: Skill level 1 occupations, which require 5 years of experience to substitute for a formal qualification, work experience must be undertaken within the last 8 years.
occupations.skills_authority: The applicant must satisfy the skills assessment requirements under the standard TSS, SESR or ENS visa programs.

occupations.quals_and_experience:
Nominees for this occupation must satisfy the following skills, qualifications, experience and employment background requirements. The applicant must: Have 1 year of work experience if applying for a TSS or SESR visa or 3 years of work experience if applying for an ENS visa; and Undergo a skills assessment by the Designated Area Representative; and Meet the skill level as defined below; Have at least a relevant AQF Diploma or higher qualification or equivalent; or
3 years of relevant work experience to substitute the qualification. Work experience must be: In the nominated occupation, or a related occupation at the same skill level. At least 20 hours per week. Undertaken within the last 3 years (TSS/SESR) or 5 years (ENS). Can be undertaken prior to commencing study, while studying or post-qualification. Can be undertaken as part of a formal arrangement such as internships, industry and clinical placements, apprenticeships and traineeships, and work experience required through the Job Ready Program (JRP). Can be served concurrently with any work experience used to substitute for formal qualifications as per ANZSCO requirements, provided that the work experience was at the same skill level. In cases where work experience is used to substitute for formal qualifications: Skill Level 2 and 3 occupations, which require 3 years of experience to substitute for a formal qualification, work experience must be undertaken within the last 5 years.

Work Experience must be: In the nominated occupation, or a related occupation at the same skill level. At least 20 hours per week. Undertaken within the last 3 years (TSS/SESR) or 5 years (ENS). Can be undertaken prior to commencing study, while studying or post-qualification. Can be undertaken as part of a formal arrangement such as internships, industry and clinical placements, apprenticeships and traineeships, and work experience required through the Job Ready Program (JRP). Can be served concurrently with any work experience used to substitute for formal qualifications as per ANZSCO requirements, provided that the work experience was at the same skill level.
